audit_items.proof_trace: The invariant is enforced bidirectionally: `try_borrow_asset` (L121-124) aborts on first borrow if `ctokens.is_supporting_collateral<MarketType,CoinType>()` is true, and `deposit_ctoken` (L86-89) aborts if `debts.contains(type_name::with_defining_ids<CoinType>())` is true. Move struct field privacy ensures `self.debts` and `self.ctokens` are only mutable through these two guarded functions; no bypass paths exist. After a full collateral withdrawal the `ctoken_values` entry is removed by `split_ctoken`, correctly allowing subsequent borrows while still blocking re-deposit of that CoinType so long as the debt remains.
